evidence.finding: April 2023-November 2024 money-fund bill holdings rose roughly $1.7tn and private Treasury repo $0.9tn as ON RRP use fell about $2tn.

claims.mechanism_assessment: See rationale; this is not a forecast hit.

framework_lessons: Bank safety needs funding and duration tests.
assessment: The best calls were the immediate Truist margin increase, slowing lending and eventual positive three-year bank/Bitcoin returns. The central blind spot was treating Treasury-heavy bank assets and cheap deposits as durable protection while concentrating on credit losses. March 2023 exposed duration and funding risks. Five-year bank outperformance remains open, with regional banks far behind SPY at the three-year checkpoint. Rejected analyst upside and conditional stress scenarios are not base-case forecasts.
